_README: Campus Student Affairs and Services Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 Edition (External Services, printed pp. 663-733). effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Each service lists all Charter transaction types in transaction_types. Standards carry duration_days, duration_hours and duration_minutes exactly as printed. See CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.3. Review before importing. Each service also carries service_scope (INTERNAL or EXTERNAL, from the Charter section it was printed in); see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 7.

services.service_name: Processing for Re-Admission (Returning Students)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Go to Admission Services and fill out the application for re-admission. 1.1 Secure clearance from accounting Office 1.2 Secure clearance from Campus Medical Clinic Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  1.1. Give Logbook and affix signature [Responsible: Admission Services Staff]
  1.2. Accept the filled out application for re-admission for verification and attach all pertinent documents needed for re-admission [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration Admission's Office]
Step 2. Proceed to the Cashier's Office to pay the amount Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  2. Accept payment and issues official receipt. [Responsible: Cash Receipts Officer Cashier's Office]
Step 3. For S.I.S. students, proceed totheAdmissionandRegistration Office to re-activate your account. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  3. Bring the proof of payment and clients copy of the application form. [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration Admission's Office]
Step 4. Request Informative Copy of Grades (If you stopped for one (1) semester); Transcript of Records (TOR) if you stopped for two (2) or more years from the date of your last enrollment in P.U.P. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  4.1. Process request and issue advisory and updates whenever necessary [Responsible: Admission Services Staff]
  4.2. Notify the client when document is ready for release. [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration Admission's Office]
Step 5. roceed to the Head of Academic Programs for academic evaluation and approval for re-admission. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  5. Evaluate the student academic records and signs the re-admission form with recommendation [Responsible: HeadofAcademicPrograms]
Step 6. Go back to Admission Services and submit two (2) sets of re-admission forms and attachments: Original and duplicate copy with 2"x2" colored photo with white background and nametag. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  6.1. Accept re-admission form and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness. [Responsible: Admission Services Staff HeadofAdmissionand Registration Admission's Office]
  6.2. If documents are in complete, indicate in the clients copy lacking form for immediate compliance and advise the date of release. [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 7. Claim the re-admission certificate and attachments on prescribed schedule. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  7. Issue certificate of re-admission and sign in the logbook and evaluate the service rendered [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 8. Proceed to the HeadofAcademicProgramsfor enrollment Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  8. Issue certificate [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs]

services.fees: PHP 200 USD 10. Processing Fee (Local Verification): PHP 200; Processing Fee (Outside the country): USD 10
services.processing_steps:

  1. Give logbook and affix signature. 1.2 Accept request and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness for walk-in. Acknowledge request for online verification 1.3 If documents are complete Return the receiving copy of letter of request If not complete, advice the client to comply with the lacking requirements otherwise the application will not be processed. [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration; Campus Student Services and Affairs Office]

  2. Processes request and issues advisory and updates whenever necessary and notify the client when document is ready for release. If the verification is processed, informs the client to pay verification fee. [Responsible: Admission and Registration Head; Campus Student Services and Affairs Office]

  3. Accepts payment of verification [Responsible: Cashier's Office; Any of requesting office / division]
Step 4. Pick up the verification results/documents for walk in Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines Notes/Instruction: Check online the emailes verification results
  4. Issues verification results Give logbook and sign and evaluate service rendered. Send thru email the verification result [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration; Campus Student Services and Affairs Office]

[Responsible: Registrar's Office Personnel]

  3. Process request and issues advisory and updates whenever necessary. 3.2 Notify the client when document is ready for release. [Responsible: Registrar's Office Personnel]
Step 4. Present clients copy of application form together with authorization letter and ID, if claimant is immediate family member or Special Power of Attorney (SPA), if claimant is other than immediate family member. Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  4. Verify the documents presented. 4.2 issue the requested certification/s. [Responsible: Registrar's Office Personnel]
Step 5. Acknowledge receipt of the requested certification/s Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  5. Request client to sign the logbook and evaluate the service rendered. [Responsible: Registrar's Office Personnel]
